# Amazon S3 Glacier

Store S3 Glacier vault configurations, access policies, notifications, and tags as records without archives or retrieval jobs.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `glacier` |
| Signing name | `glacier` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2012-06-01` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Configuration records only |
| Selected operations | 13 of 33 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#amazon-s3-glacier) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Records-only control plane: archive storage (UploadArchive, DeleteArchive), retrieval jobs (InitiateJob, DescribeJob, GetJobOutput), multipart uploads, and vault lock workflows are not implemented.
- DescribeVault and ListVaults always report zero archives and zero vault bytes.
- AccountId parameters must match the authenticated account ID or standard "-" alias; foreign account IDs reject with InvalidParameterValueException.
- Vault access policies and notification configurations return 404 ResourceNotFoundException when queried before being configured or after deletion.
- Extended archive operations and retrieval execution are deferred to future roadmap slices.
- No CloudFormation resource: the CloudFormation resource specification defines no Glacier vault type.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.

[protocol handling](../architecture/request-flow.md). Supported members are selected separately in the
